text: its not bad. its not great either if im being honest but its a hell of a lot better than what it was haha it will do for now.can u add some sort of legend or something that will tell me the size of a face/edge i have in focus so i stop needing to remember it
resolution: Added a live selection size readout to the Studio editor so the dimensions of the focused face/edge/vert don't have to be remembered. New pure vertsBounds() returns a vert subset's axis-aligned min/max + per-axis size; a bottom-left legend (stacked above the view compass) shows it in modeling units (16u = 1 tile = 1 m), with X/Y/Z colour-matched to the compass axes. A single selected edge shows its true Euclidean length ('Nu long') instead of a box; faces/verts/multi-selections and object-mode show W×H×D. It reads the LIVE mesh (the drag draft when dragging) so the numbers update as you resize, and is hidden in rig mode or with nothing selected. Verified: editMesh suite 59/59 (incl. a flat-face degenerate-axis case), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Committed 913c97960.
